gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: ___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.
gaps.hint: participle adjective: how the board felt
gaps.explanation: 'Disappointed with the results' — the board experienced disappointment; '-ing' would describe the results.
'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.
